parameters.query: SELECT * FROM newsletter_emails_commandes WHERE statut = 'recu' LIMIT 10;
UPDATE newsletter_emails_commandes SET statut = 'en_traitement' WHERE id = $1;
SELECT prenom, themes, periodicite FROM newsletter_abonnes WHERE email = $1 LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO newsletter_abonnes (prenom, email, themes, periodicite, actif)
VALUES (
  split_part($1, '@', 1),
  $1,
  (SELECT array_agg(nom) FROM newsletter_themes WHERE nom != 'Autre'),
  $2,
  true
)
ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING;
UPDATE newsletter_abonnes SET actif = false, date_modification = now() WHERE email = $1;

UPDATE newsletter_emails_commandes
SET statut = 'a_envoyer',
    action_detectee = $2,
    reponse_texte = '{{ $('Parser réponse Ollama').item.json.reponse_texte }}',
    date_traitement = now()
WHERE id = $1;
UPDATE newsletter_emails_commandes SET statut = 'erreur', erreur_detail = $2, date_traitement = now() WHERE id = $1;
